grammar.summary: 本课学习 both...and 与地址场景表达。

points.title: both...and 结构
points.explanation: both...and... 连接两个并列成分，谓语用复数：Both my sister and I received letters. 注意 either...or 与 neither...nor 的后续课程呼应。

examples.en: Both girls write to each other regularly now.
examples.cn: 现在两个姑娘定期互相通信。

points.title: each other 与 one another
points.explanation: write to each other 互相写信，each other 指两者之间，one another 指三者以上。

examples.en: The girls write to each other frequently.
examples.cn: 两个姑娘频繁地互相写信。
